description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericAsyncEngine' that extends 'AbstractEngine' and provides asynchronous service execution capabilities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for running services synchronously and asynchronously, with support for persisted jobs and job management.

classes.name: GenericAsyncEngine
classes.description: An abstract class providing asynchronous service execution, including support for persisted jobs and job management within the OFBiz framework.
